text:
Priya: FYI renewal for Zephyrus is due 2026-04-18. They want a 9mo term (instead of 12), +25 seats, and a one-day enablement workshop. Procurement raised two blockers: vendor code mismatch and request for EU data residency clause. Need quick decision on pricing and signature path.

Ben: Pricing note — with +25 seats we can do a 15% uplift on current rate, but offer a one-time training credit of $6k to land the enablement. That keeps ARR simple. @Priya is this acceptable to the AMs?

Priya: 15% sounds ok, we should model a prorated invoice for the 9mo term. Also customer asked for net45 payment terms. Can we do net45 on a renewal of this size?

Maya (CS Ops): Net45 is fine if Legal signs off and Sales approves. I can add a payment term flag to the SOW.

Sarah (Legal): Re: EU data residency — customer wants explicit clause guaranteeing EU-only processing for customer content. We can offer an addendum referencing our EU region deployments + KMS in EU, but we can't change the core SLA. I'll draft a short addendum. Need a contact from Zephyrus to route redlines.

Ben: I'll ask their procurement for the redline contact. Also procurement included vendor_code ZEP-001 but our billing entity expects ZP-001. Is that the same org with a different code?

Priya: It is the same org; they have two legacy billing codes across subsidiaries. Procurement insists the PO must use ZEP-001. Ops, can we accept invoice with ZEP-001 on the PO but charge under our existing vendor record?

Maya (CS Ops): We can accept the PO with ZEP-001 but accounting needs a memo. I'll raise a quick ticket with finance and attach the PO. Please confirm the PO number when you have it.

Luke: I'll pull last 90-day usage and latency summary for Zephyrus — legal asked for any infra residency proof. I can include region logs showing EU region usage (sanitized).

Priya: Great. Timeline: need signed docs by 4/11 to get provisioning scheduled week of 4/20. If legal redlines take too long, risk slipping onboarding and they mentioned evaluating a competitor. High priority.

Ben: Ok — two actionable asks: 1) @Sarah (Legal) to post the addendum draft by EOD tomorrow; 2) @Maya to confirm finance can accept ZEP-001 and whether any reconciliation docs needed. I'll ping procurement for redline contact.

Sarah (Legal): Will post draft addendum by EOD tomorrow. It will reference: EU-only processing, KMS in EU, and a 30-day SLO to notify of transfer requests. Not changing SLA metrics.

Maya (CS Ops): Confirmed — finance can accept alternate vendor code with a reconciliation memo and PO uploaded to the ticket. I'll create ticket now: INV-7834 and link here when done.

DocuSign Bot: DocuSign envelope created by Ben: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/0X-ABC123 — status: created. Recipients: Zephyrus Procurement, Priya, Ben.

Priya: Thanks. Once legal posts addendum I'll attach to the envelope and route to Zephyrus. If procurement insists on net45, we can include payment term in the SOW and get billing approval.

Ben: I'll escalate to my manager if redlines come back late — we can't lose the deal. Also proposing a short exec intro call with Zephyrus CTO to reassure them on residency and roadmap.

Priya: +1 to exec intro. I'll set 15-min for Thursday.

Maya (CS Ops): INV-7834 created and linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INV-7834 — finance assigned. Leaving a comment to accept ZEP-001 with memo.

Sarah (Legal): Draft posted: https://drive.redwood/legal/zephyrus-eu-addendum-v1.docx — comments welcome.

Luke: Pushed EU-region usage export to the legal drive folder and sanitized logs. Link in the doc comment.

Priya: Great momentum. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: when you've completed your action so I can close the loop?
